tools.name: search
tools.description: Search South African FSCA RE5 & RE1 statutory study guides and published Moonstone exam questions by keyword.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full statutory Markdown content, question rationale, and metadata of an FSCA study guide or published exam question by slug, ID, or URL.

tools.name: search_study_guides
tools.description: Search and retrieve authoritative South African FSCA RE5 & RE1 statutory study guides (FAIS Act 37 of 2002, Board Notice 194 of 2017, General Code of Conduct, Section 14 Debarment, FICA Act 38 of 2001, and Moonstone exam strategies).

tools.name: search_exam_questions
tools.description: Search published South African FSCA RE5 & RE1 Moonstone-style practice exam questions across Qualifying Criteria Tasks 1 to 8, including statutory references, correct answers, and trap rationales.

tools.name: calculate_exam_pass_mark
tools.description: Calculate statutory FSCA RE5 (Representatives: 50 questions, 66% / 33/50) or RE1 (Key Individuals: 80 questions, 65% / 52/80) pass criteria, allowed errors, and daily study quota.

tools.name: get_exam_pass_plan

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
